story.title: Story 3: Turn Composition and Chunk Formation

result.planSummary: Fixed SV-3.8-001 with production behavior, not test-only marking. Tool-run receipts are now a mechanical artifact: composeRenderingInput (pure) restates each tool part as a ToolRunReceipt { messageId, activity, account, outcome } in message order, and the turn_derivation handler stamps them on turn_rendering.metadata (mechanically derived, never provider-authored — consistent with the existing metadata contract). The two chunk-summary provider inputs now differ by contract: summarizeChunkDetailed receives memberReceipts (full receipts per member, turn order, read from the renderings' stamped metadata via the member-projection query); summarizeChunkBrief receives memberOutcomes only — the receipt account text is stripped in the handler before the provider call, so brief structurally cannot preserve more than outcomes. The deterministic provider and the test double render these fields into the marked output through shared suffix helpers ([receipts account=>outcome; …] on detailed, [outcomes …] on brief), so the landed artifacts carry the evidence and in-process/spawned outputs stay byte-identical. The new seam fields are optional in the type (frozen fixtures.test.ts calls with memberProjections only still typecheck, and empty-receipt inputs produce byte-identical output to before, keeping FC-0.1/0.2 and TC-3.9 determinism green). Independent retry/requeue behavior (TC-3.8 leg 2) untouched and green.

findingsFixed: SV-3.8-001: chunk_summary_detailed and chunk_summary_brief previously received identical inputs and differed only by output marker; now detailed's input and artifact preserve tool-activity receipts (account text + outcome per call/result, in turn and message order) and brief's input is stripped to outcomes before the provider is called — asserted at the metadata layer, the captured seam input, and the landed artifact content (13/13 targeted tests, 176 green-verify, 195 verify-all)
findingsSurfaced: The new seam fields are optional in DerivationProvider so the red-frozen fixtures.test.ts seven-op sweep (which calls the chunk ops with memberProjections only) still typechecks and produces byte-identical output; the production chunk handlers always pass the fields. A custom provider supplied by a host could omit them — acceptable because the handler-side strip (brief never sees receipt text) is what enforces the contract, not provider goodwill.

Receipt account text reflects what composition used: a tool form that fell back at rendering time yields a truncated-fallback account in the receipt, consistent with the gap-as-recorded-fact rule — an explicit rebuild restates receipts from current form states.

Receipts are stamped only when the turn has tool activity (no metadata otherwise), keeping all prior Story 3 artifacts byte-identical — TC-3.3's byte-equality and TC-3.9's replay equality passed unchanged.

specDeviations: Tech design §Interfaces sketches both chunk-summary provider inputs as { memberProjections: string[] }; satisfying AC-3.8's preserve-receipts/outcomes-only contract mechanically required differentiating them — summarizeChunkDetailed gains optional memberReceipts: ToolRunReceipt[][], summarizeChunkBrief gains optional memberOutcomes: ToolOutcome[][], with receipts mechanically stamped on turn_rendering.metadata at derivation. Additive and optional, so existing seam callers are unaffected.
test/red-manifest.json re-recorded for the revised derivation-turns.test.ts (the suite this follow-up explicitly amends), per the F-03 regenerate-and-note procedure.
